purpose: Paired raw-versus-processed experiment with wholly independent QC selection of validation and evaluation rows.
features: 11 original variables x 24 lags = 264; no masks, quality flags, calendar, station/coordinates or rolling summaries.
raw_pollutants: Original local values; zeros retained; no EEA fields are read.
minimal_preparation: Hourly alignment, rejection of nonfinite/negative pollutant values, training-only pooled median imputation and IQR scaling.
targets: Raw measured PM10 in training; targets never imputed.
validation_and_evaluation: Exactly the independent-QC arm inner validation, meta, calibration and complete test rows. Their target values must equal the original observations.
selection: Same optimizer budgets, hidden sizes, losses, seed, and chronological boundaries; all final models refitted from scratch.
comparison: Paired scores on the entire independent test, not an intersection with a previous externally selected test.
limits: Combined intervention includes QC, features, input imputation and training sample selection.
One seed and previously inspected historical period; not a new untouched external test.
Raw training includes more zero-placeholder observations; numerical preparation is still required.
